name: Gale Reef
description: Escape to Emerald Bay for a relaxing getaway surrounded by beautiful coastal scenery. Enjoy five days of exploring the area, unwinding by the water, and experiencing a memorable vacation.

name: Dawson's Reef
description: Discover the beauty of Blue Lagoon on a five-day tropical escape. With stunning waters and plenty of opportunities for relaxation and adventure, this getaway offers something for every traveler.

name: Claire's Reef
description: Experience an unforgettable stay at Coral Sands. Enjoy a luxurious coastal retreat with beautiful beaches, breathtaking scenery, and five days dedicated to relaxation and adventure.

name: Mega Reef Dive
description: Explore the wonders of the Great Barrier Reef on this seven-day diving adventure. Discover vibrant coral reefs, encounter incredible marine life, and enjoy a week surrounded by one of the world's most breathtaking natural destinations.
